name: 22653-sharegpt-jamba-mini-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism off.
architecture: JambaForCausalLM, a 32-block hybrid decoder with a top-2 MoE FFN on every other block; 51.6B total / 12B active parameters.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1000 -- all 1000 requests offered at once, which is what the source's `benchmark_serving.py` run did (no --request-rate, no --max-concurrency). Effective in-flight is then whatever the KV/state pools admit, exactly as it was for the source on the same 80 GB card. Warmup 20% (200 requests dropped), cooldown 10%.
workload: 1000 single-turn ShareGPT conversations, materialised by `configs/data/make-dataset.py` (seed-0 shuffle, first two turns, 4 <= prompt <= 1024 and prompt + reply <= 2048, first 1000 survivors; the script asserts 235326 prompt / 218837 reply tokens before writing). Mean 235 prompt / 219 output tokens, max 1024 / 1073. Each reply's own length is ENFORCED, so the generated-token total is fixed at 218837.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on a hybrid mixture-of-experts model, serving 1000 short single-turn conversations at once on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. vLLM built from commit 5406ebf5c9606b717ee11a40db8ba56d8c8dde17.

model: ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Mini-1.7-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# What makes the checkpoint fit one 80 GB card: 55.1 GB of compressed-tensors FP8 weights
# (channelwise W8A8, dynamic per-token activations) on Linear layers only. The checkpoint carries
# its own `quantization_config`, so no `quantization:` key is set here -- forcing one would
# override the scheme the weights were serialised against.

# LOAD-BEARING: a property of this setup, not a workaround to remove.
enforce-eager: true

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 32768

# PINNED to what `vllm serve` itself picks on a >= 70 GiB non-A100 card. The fallback default of
# 128 / 2048 would put the sequence cap below this item's 256 concurrent streams.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
